draft.subject: Richpanel — Japan rollout for subscription support
draft.body:
Hi Richpanel team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company supporting commerce technology companies with Japan market development. We’re contacting Richpanel about policy-driven subscription support for Japanese Shopify supplement brands handling skips, address changes, and cancellations.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean CX teams, an agent that reads orders, applies approved policies, and escalates exceptions could reduce repetitive ticket handling without weakening control.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide policy localization, approval boundaries, and deployment priorities. Can we help plan and execute Richpanel’s Japan rollout for these support teams?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
